title: Harden loading and auth UX
description: Add stream watchdog, bounded one-shot fallback, clear retryable payroll error UI, and proxy-safe login redirects for expired tokens. Avoid endless loading if SSE stalls, returns HTML, 401, 403, or 404.
convergence: A stalled or failed stream reaches visible error/retry state within bounded timeout; valid fallback fetch runs once; expired auth redirects intentionally.
